title: Acceptance evaluator's evidence-catalog read fails mid-catalog with an expired cursor, so the evaluator ends with no verdict
outcome: An independent acceptance evaluator can read an item's whole captured acceptance-evidence catalog during one evaluation, or the host refuses the evaluation up front with a stated reason. It never fails mid-catalog with "the captured evidence read is unavailable or its cursor expired" and ends with no submission.
acceptance: The cause of the mid-catalog expiry observed on 2026-11-15 (delegation-58398341 attempt 1, catalog-11, read cut project_position 215069, 62 oldest entries unread) is identified from source and recorded on this item.
A regression test reproduces a catalog large enough to page past the observed point and shows the evaluator reads every entry, or gets a defined up-front refusal, without a cursor expiry.
A failed evaluator attempt caused by this defect is reported to the requester as an evaluator infrastructure failure, distinct from a criterion verdict.
